0022600128.text: The Nets (0-3, fifth in the Atlantic and 14th in the East) visit the Celtics (2-1, second in the Atlantic) for Brooklyn's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Nets on a three-game losing streak. Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder sprain, and Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost the series 1-3, including a 148-111 loss in Boston on February 27, 2026.
